title: Commercial Sector
description: We provide comprehensive facade solutions for commercial buildings in Riyadh and Saudi Arabia — from office towers to shopping centres — to the highest standards of quality and thermal performance.
shortDescription: Facade solutions for towers and commercial centres in Saudi Arabia

faq.question: Can you work in occupied commercial buildings?
faq.answer: Yes, we have extensive experience executing facade works in operating buildings through pre-coordination with management and commitment to designated zones and night-time work schedules when necessary.

en: aluminum works commercial buildings Saudi Arabia

title: Residential Sector
description: We specialise in aluminium, glass, and decorative ironwork for villas, residential compounds, and towers in Riyadh — designs that combine luxury with functionality.
shortDescription: Premium aluminium and glass works for villas and residential complexes

faq.question: Do you provide a warranty on villa works?
faq.answer: Yes, we provide a full 5-year warranty on all aluminium and glass works in residential projects, covering both materials and installation.

title: Government Sector
description: We have a strong track record executing facade projects for government entities and official institutions, fully compliant with the highest quality standards and approved engineering codes in Saudi Arabia.
shortDescription: Facade solutions for government and institutional buildings

faq.question: Are you registered for government tender pre-qualification?
faq.answer: Yes, Al Fahd Contracting is registered and pre-qualified for government projects under the contractors classification approved by the Ministry of Municipal and Rural Affairs, with an established track record with multiple government entities.

title: Industrial Sector
description: We deliver integrated steel structure and aluminium cladding solutions for factories, warehouses, and industrial facilities — with chemical- and marine-resistant treatments.
shortDescription: Steel structures and aluminium cladding for factories and industrial facilities

faq.question: Can you build steel structures for hazardous industrial areas?
faq.answer: Yes, we design and fabricate corrosion-resistant steel structures with specialist coatings for hazardous industrial zones, including chemical environments and marine coastal settings.

title: Hospitality & Hotels Sector
description: We specialise in luxury hotel and resort facades that combine premium architectural aesthetics with superior technical performance, with strict schedule adherence and the highest finishing standards.
shortDescription: Luxury facades for hotels and tourist resorts

faq.question: Do your systems comply with LEED green building standards for hotels?
faq.answer: Yes, we provide an integrated facade system compatible with LEED and BREEAM requirements, including Low-E glass, low-carbon aluminium profiles, and documented thermal performance.

title: Healthcare Sector
description: We deliver specialist facade solutions for hospitals and healthcare centres compliant with the highest acoustic and thermal insulation standards, using health-safe materials aligned with healthcare sector requirements.
shortDescription: Facade solutions for hospitals and healthcare centres with strict health standards

faq.question: What acoustic insulation requirements do hospitals need?
faq.answer: Hospitals generally require 40–50 dB STC acoustic insulation for medical rooms, and up to 55 dB for operating theatres and ICUs. We provide double and triple-glazed window systems with heavy-duty seals to achieve these requirements.
